Name: PvZ2_Prerelease_PinataParty_1_Fixed

Updates.en: You must play through Egypt 7 or fix your data (Player-Property Window) to enter the Piñata Party.
Updates.zh: 现在需要通关埃及 7 或者修复存档（在玩家数据窗口）以进入彩陶盛宴。

Updates.en: Added new currency (tickets), dropped in the Piñata Parties. Cleared at 00:00 a.m. on Sunday.
Updates.zh: 加入新货币（票券），通过彩陶盛宴获得，其每周日凌晨会被清除。

Updates.en: Plants, such as Shooting Starfruit, now require tickets to obtain. One of the 'Ticket Plants' will be on sale each week.
Updates.zh: 流星果等植物现在需要票券获得，每周会有一株票券植物得到特价。

Updates.en: Added epic levels for Goo Peashooter (By the community).
Updates.zh: 加入黏毒豌豆史诗任务（由社区编制）。
